title: Associate Product Manager Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to build product sense, core PM tools, and a showcase portfolio from scratch. By the end you’ll be ready to join a product team or pitch yourself to hiring managers.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Learn the product mindset, basic discovery, and communication basics.

milestones.title: Product Thinking Basics
milestones.outcome: You can explain what product management is and how it adds value to a business.

tasks.title: Read Intro to Product Management
tasks.description: Read the first two chapters of the free “Product Management 101” guide on Mind the Product.

tasks.title: Watch Customer Discovery Video
tasks.description: Watch the 15‑minute “Customer Discovery Basics” video on the Product School YouTube channel.

tasks.title: Summarize Key Concepts
tasks.description: Write a 200‑word summary of the three main questions every PM asks during discovery.

tasks.title: Discuss with Peer
tasks.description: Join a free product‑management Slack community and share your summary, asking for feedback.

milestones.title: User Research Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can conduct a simple interview and synthesize findings into insights.

tasks.title: Read Interview Guide
tasks.description: Read the free “User Interview Guide” on the Nielsen Norman Group website.

tasks.title: Create Interview Script
tasks.description: Draft a 5‑question script for a target user segment of a hypothetical app.

tasks.title: Conduct Mock Interview
tasks.description: Pair with a friend and run the interview, recording notes.

tasks.title: Extract Insights Sheet
tasks.description: Summarize the interview notes into three actionable insights in a Google Sheet.

milestones.title: Communication Foundations
milestones.outcome: You can craft clear, concise written updates for stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read Writing for PMs Article
tasks.description: Read the free article “Writing Clear Product Updates” on ProductPlan blog.

tasks.title: Draft a Status Update
tasks.description: Write a one‑page status update for a fictional sprint, using the template from the article.

tasks.title: Peer Review Update
tasks.description: Share the draft in a product‑management forum and incorporate feedback.

tasks.title: Revise and Finalize
tasks.description: Polish the update for clarity and brevity, aiming for under 300 words.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop the core PM toolbox: specs, roadmaps, prioritisation, and metrics.

milestones.title: Writing Effective Specs
milestones.outcome: You can produce a concise product requirement document (PRD).

tasks.title: Read PRD Template
tasks.description: Study the free PRD template on Aha! blog.

tasks.title: Outline Feature PRD
tasks.description: Choose a simple feature (e.g., “bookmark articles”) and outline its PRD sections.

tasks.title: Fill Feature Details
tasks.description: Write the problem statement, user personas, and acceptance criteria for the feature.

tasks.title: Get Feedback
tasks.description: Post the draft in a product community and request two specific critiques.

tasks.title: Iterate PRD
tasks.description: Revise the PRD based on feedback, focusing on clarity and testability.

milestones.title: Prioritisation & Roadmapping
milestones.outcome: You can create a simple roadmap and apply a prioritisation framework.

tasks.title: Learn RICE Framework
tasks.description: Read the free “RICE Scoring Model” article on Intercom blog.

tasks.title: Score Sample Ideas
tasks.description: Apply RICE to five hypothetical feature ideas in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Build a Quarterly Roadmap
tasks.description: Use a free roadmap template from ProductPlan to plot the top three ideas over 12 weeks.

tasks.title: Present Roadmap Mock
tasks.description: Record a 3‑minute video explaining the roadmap rationale and share for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on Trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a short note on the biggest trade‑off you faced and how you resolved it.

milestones.title: Metrics & Analytics Basics
milestones.outcome: You can define success metrics and design a simple analytics plan.

tasks.title: Read Metrics Fundamentals
tasks.description: Read the free “Metrics for Product Managers” guide on Mixpanel blog.

tasks.title: Define Success Metrics
tasks.description: For the bookmark feature, list three quantitative metrics and one qualitative metric.

tasks.title: Create Analytics Plan
tasks.description: Sketch a basic event tracking plan using a free Google Analytics template.

tasks.title: Validate with Peer
tasks.description: Share the plan in a product forum and ask for validation of metric relevance.

tasks.title: Reflect on Measurement
tasks.description: Write a brief reflection on how metrics will guide future decisions for the feature.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply the toolbox to real‑world portfolio pieces.

milestones.title: Product Teardown
milestones.outcome: You can critique an existing product and identify improvement opportunities.

tasks.title: Select a Product
tasks.description: Choose a consumer app you use daily and install the free “Product Teardown” worksheet from Medium.

tasks.title: Analyze Core Flows
tasks.description: Map the main user flow and note friction points in the worksheet.

tasks.title: Identify 3 Opportunities
tasks.description: Write three concrete improvement suggestions with supporting user evidence.

tasks.title: Create Teardown Report
tasks.description: Compile findings into a 2‑page PDF using the provided template.

tasks.title: Publish on Portfolio
tasks.description: Upload the PDF to a personal website or LinkedIn and add a brief description.

milestones.title: Feature PRD Portfolio Piece
milestones.outcome: You can deliver a polished PRD ready for stakeholder review.

tasks.title: Choose Feature Idea
tasks.description: Select a realistic feature for a well‑known product (e.g., “dark mode” for a news app).

tasks.title: Research User Need
tasks.description: Gather three user quotes from reviews or forums supporting the need.

tasks.title: Write Full PRD
tasks.description: Complete the PRD template with problem, goals, specs, and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Design Mock Screens
tasks.description: Create low‑fidelity wireframes using Figma’s free starter plan.

tasks.title: Seek Mentor Review
tasks.description: Send the PRD and mocks to a senior PM on LinkedIn for feedback.

tasks.title: Finalize Portfolio Entry
tasks.description: Add the PRD, mocks, and feedback summary to your portfolio site.

milestones.title: Metrics Plan for Launch
milestones.outcome: You can craft a launch analytics plan linking metrics to business goals.

tasks.title: Pick a Launch Scenario
tasks.description: Imagine launching the dark mode feature and define the launch timeline.

tasks.title: Select Success KPIs
tasks.description: Choose three primary KPIs (e.g., activation rate, retention, NPS).

tasks.title: Design Tracking Events
tasks.description: Map required events in a free Amplitude event schema template.

tasks.title: Create Dashboard Mock
tasks.description: Build a simple dashboard in Google Data Studio using sample data.

tasks.title: Present Plan Mock
tasks.description: Record a 2‑minute walkthrough of the plan and share for critique.

tasks.title: Reflect on Learnings
tasks.description: Write a short note on how the metrics will inform post‑launch decisions.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance your expertise, build a network, and prepare for interviews or client pitches.

milestones.title: Advanced Roadmapping & Strategy
milestones.outcome: You can align product roadmaps with company OKRs and articulate strategy.

tasks.title: Read OKR Alignment Article
tasks.description: Read the free “Aligning Roadmaps with OKRs” guide on Atlassian blog.

tasks.title: Map Feature to OKR
tasks.description: Take the bookmark feature and link its outcomes to a sample company OKR.

tasks.title: Update Quarterly Roadmap
tasks.description: Revise the earlier roadmap to reflect OKR alignment and dependencies.

tasks.title: Explain Strategy Video
tasks.description: Record a 3‑minute video explaining the strategic fit and share for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on Alignment
tasks.description: Write a brief reflection on challenges of aligning multiple stakeholders.

milestones.title: Stakeholder Communication Mastery
milestones.outcome: You can run effective meetings, write persuasive briefs, and handle objections.

tasks.title: Study Meeting Framework
tasks.description: Read the free “Running Effective Product Meetings” article on ProductTalk.

tasks.title: Create Meeting Agenda
tasks.description: Draft a 20‑minute agenda for a stakeholder kickoff on the dark mode feature.

tasks.title: Facilitate Role‑Play Meeting
tasks.description: With a peer, simulate the kickoff meeting and record key moments.

tasks.title: Write Persuasive Brief
tasks.description: Compose a one‑page brief arguing for the feature’s priority using data.

tasks.title: Get Feedback from Mentor
tasks.description: Send the brief to a senior PM for critique and incorporate suggestions.

tasks.title: Reflect on Communication
tasks.description: Note two communication habits you will keep and two to improve.

milestones.title: Interview & Job‑Ready Prep
milestones.outcome: You can confidently answer PM interview questions and present your portfolio.

tasks.title: Review Common PM Questions
tasks.description: Read the free “Top 20 Product Manager Interview Questions” on Glassdoor Blog.

tasks.title: Craft STAR Stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR‑formatted stories highlighting discovery, prioritisation, and metrics work.

tasks.title: Mock Interview Session
tasks.description: Schedule a 30‑minute mock interview with a peer and record feedback.

tasks.title: Portfolio Walkthrough Deck
tasks.description: Create a 5‑slide deck summarizing your three portfolio projects.

tasks.title: Network Outreach
tasks.description: Send personalized LinkedIn messages to five product managers requesting informational chats.

tasks.title: Reflect on Gaps
tasks.description: Write a short note on any skill gaps and plan next steps for continuous learning.
